reports.title: Duke Energy reports third-quarter 2026 financial results

lines: ▪Company narrows 2026 adjusted EPS guidance range to $6.70 to $6.80; strong year-to-date performance positions company to deliver results near the top end

The company is narrowing its 2026 adjusted EPS guidance range to $6.70 to $6.80 and reaffirming its long-term adjusted EPS growth rate of 5% to 7% through 2030 off the 2025 guidance range midpoint of $6.30, with confidence to earn in the top half of the range beginning in 2028.

desk.headline: EPS up 10% to $1.99, beat; 2026 guidance narrowed to $6.70–6.80 with results seen near the top
results: Reported and adjusted EPS rose 10% to $1.99 from $1.81; operating revenue grew 6.6% to $9.1bn.
Electric utilities earned $1.8bn, helped by new rates (+16c a share), higher volumes (+10c) and favourable weather (+8c).
Higher depreciation, interest costs, minority-interest effects and a higher tax rate (15.3% vs 10.8%) held back part of the gain.
The gas unit's seasonal loss narrowed to $19m; corporate costs rose on higher insurance claims.
Nine-month adjusted EPS is $5.35, up from $4.81, with operating cash flow of $7.9bn.

guidance.summary: Duke narrowed its 2026 adjusted EPS range to $6.70–6.80 and expects to land near the top; it reaffirmed 5–7% yearly EPS growth to 2030, aiming for the top half from 2028.

points: Electricity demand grew about 2% in the quarter, the fastest since 2022, and load growth of 3–4% a year is expected over the five-year plan.
Data centres totalling 5.2 GW are under construction, due to start taking power from late 2027 into 2028; turning the wider pipeline into contracts is going slower than hoped.
The capital plan is $103bn, with $5–10bn of possible extra spending tied to large customers; 16 GW of new generation is planned by 2031.
About a third of the $10bn equity need is already covered, and a $1bn Brookfield investment in Duke Energy Florida is being brought forward to December.
New nuclear will only go ahead with clear protections for customers and the balance sheet.
call.source: Call coverage: Yahoo Finance call summary (5 Nov 2026) and ad-hoc-news.de (6 Nov 2026); no prepared remarks filed

watch: North Carolina rate case orders expected in November, with new rates from January 2027.
Conversion of the data-centre pipeline into signed electric service agreements.
Refiled large-load tariff in Florida and equity issuance pace.
